passage.traditional: 今天天氣{1}熱了，我很渴。我和宜文去一家飲料店。這家店賣很多{2}飲料：果汁、牛奶、咖啡、茶，{3}很好喝。我要一杯果汁，宜文{4}要一杯果汁。
passage.simplified: 今天天气{1}热了，我很渴。我和宜文去一家饮料店。这家店卖很多{2}饮料：果汁、牛奶、咖啡、茶，{3}很好喝。我要一杯果汁，宜文{4}要一杯果汁。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ hěn kě. Wǒ hé Yíwén qù yì jiā yǐnliào diàn. Zhè jiā diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào: guǒzhī, niúnǎi, kāfēi, chá, dōu hěn hǎohē. Wǒ yào yì bēi guǒzhī, Yíwén yě yào yì bēi guǒzhī.
passage.english: It's too hot today, and I'm thirsty. Yiwen and I go to a drink shop. It sells many kinds of drinks: juice, milk, coffee and tea are all good. I get a cup of juice, and Yiwen gets one too.

questions.why: 太 goes with 了 at the end: 太熱了 means too hot.
種 means kind: 很多種飲料 means many kinds of drinks.
都 sums up the whole list: juice, milk, coffee and tea are all good.
也 means also: Yiwen gets juice too. 都 needs more than one person.

passage.traditional: 星期六，宜文{1}三個朋友去一家餐廳吃飯。那家餐廳的牛肉麵{2}好吃了，也不貴，宜文{3}天都想來吃。他們點四碗牛肉麵和四杯茶。宜文：「小姐，一共{4}錢？」
passage.simplified: 星期六，宜文{1}三个朋友去一家餐厅吃饭。那家餐厅的牛肉面{2}好吃了，也不贵，宜文{3}天都想来吃。他们点四碗牛肉面和四杯茶。宜文：「小姐，一共{4}钱？」
passage.pinyin: Xīngqíliù, Yíwén qǐng sān ge péngyǒu qù yì jiā cāntīng chī fàn. Nà jiā cāntīng de niúròu miàn tài hǎochī le, yě bú guì, Yíwén měi tiān dōu xiǎng lái chī. Tāmen diǎn sì wǎn niúròu miàn hé sì bēi chá. Yíwén: “Xiǎojiě, yígòng duōshǎo qián?”
passage.english: On Saturday, Yiwen treats three friends to a meal at a restaurant. Its beef noodles are so good, and not expensive: Yiwen wants to come every day. They order four bowls of beef noodles and four cups of tea. Yiwen: “Miss, how much is it altogether?”

questions.why: 請 + someone means to treat or invite them: 宜文請三個朋友 means Yiwen treats three friends.
太 goes with 了 at the end: 太好吃了 means so delicious.
每天 means every day: 每天都想來 means she wants to come every day.
Ask about money with 多少錢. 幾 is for small counts with a measure word, like 幾杯.

text.traditional:
友美：
我今天中午很忙，不回家吃午飯。我想去那家牛肉麵店吃麵。他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也不貴，一碗一百多塊。妳要不要一起去？我們十二點去，好嗎？
中明
text.simplified:
友美：
我今天中午很忙，不回家吃午饭。我想去那家牛肉面店吃面。他们的牛肉面很好吃，也不贵，一碗一百多块。你要不要一起去？我们十二点去，好吗？
中明
text.pinyin: Yǒuměi: Wǒ jīntiān zhōngwǔ hěn máng, bù huí jiā chī wǔfàn. Wǒ xiǎng qù nà jiā niúròu miàn diàn chī miàn. Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě bú guì, yì wǎn yì bǎi duō kuài. Nǐ yào bu yào yìqǐ qù? Wǒmen shí'èr diǎn qù, hǎo ma? Zhōngmíng
text.english: Youmei: I'm busy at noon today, so I won't go home for lunch. I want to eat at that beef noodle shop. Their noodles are tasty and not expensive, a little over 100 a bowl. Do you want to come? Shall we go at twelve? Zhongming

prompt.traditional: 中明今天中午要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 中明今天中午要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhōngmíng jīntiān zhōngwǔ yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is Zhongming going to do at noon today?

questions.why: He writes 不回家吃午飯 and 想去那家牛肉麵店吃麵.

text.traditional:
友美：
明天是我的生日，我想請妳和中明來我家吃蛋糕。晚上七點，好嗎？
宜文
text.simplified:
友美：
明天是我的生日，我想请你和中明来我家吃蛋糕。晚上七点，好吗？
宜文
text.pinyin: Yǒuměi: Míngtiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ hé Zhōngmíng lái wǒ jiā chī dàngāo. Wǎnshang qī diǎn, hǎo ma? Yíwén
text.english: Youmei: Tomorrow is my birthday. I'd like to invite you and Zhongming to my place for cake. Seven in the evening, OK? Yiwen

prompt.english: What is Yiwen going to do tomorrow?

choices.pinyin: qǐng péngyǒu lái tā jiā chī dàngāo

choices.english: go and buy a birthday present

questions.why: She writes 請妳和中明來我家吃蛋糕: she is inviting friends to her home for cake.
